name: Open field
description: Free exploration of an empty square arena. Measures locomotor activity and anxiety-like behaviour: anxious animals stay near the walls and avoid the center.

parameters.label: Arena width
parameters.help: Inside width of the arena floor, wall to wall, along the horizontal axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Arena depth
parameters.help: Inside depth of the arena floor, wall to wall, along the vertical axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Center zone size
parameters.help: Side of the center square as a share of the arena side. 50% makes the center half as wide and half as deep as the arena.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

parameters.label: Immobility speed threshold
parameters.help: Below this speed the animal counts as immobile.

parameters.label: Shortest immobility period
parameters.help: Immobile periods shorter than this are not counted.

zones.label: Center
zones.geometry: Axis-aligned rectangle centered in the arena; each side is center_fraction of the arena side. The boundary belongs to the center.

zones.label: Periphery
zones.geometry: Arena area outside the center zone.

events.label: In center
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in the center.

events.label: Immobile
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals with speed below immobility_threshold_cm_s, lasting at least min_immobility_bout_s.

events.label: Center entry
events.definition: Time of the later sample of a counted interval that moves from periphery to center.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Time covered by counted intervals. Samples are arena-local centimeters with the origin at one arena corner; x in [0, width], y in [0, height]. Samples outside the arena count as lost. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive samples that are both tracked and inside the arena, with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Distance traveled
metrics.description: Total length of the path the animal walked.
metrics.definition: Path length over counted intervals; lost frames are not interpolated.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Mean speed
metrics.description: Distance traveled divided by the analyzed duration.
metrics.definition: Distance traveled divided by analyzed duration.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in center
metrics.description: Less time in the center suggests more anxiety-like behaviour.
metrics.definition: Counted interval time whose earlier sample is in the center zone.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in center)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in periphery
metrics.description: Time spent near the walls, outside the center.
metrics.definition: Counted interval time whose earlier sample is outside the center zone.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in periphery)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time in center
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent in the center.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration spent in the center.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time in periphery
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent near the walls.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration spent in the periphery.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Center entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal walked into the center.
metrics.definition: Counted intervals moving from periphery to center. A trajectory starting in the center does not count as an entry; no debounce is applied in version 1.
metrics.formula: count(counted intervals with earlier sample in periphery and later sample in center)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Immobility time
metrics.description: Time spent not moving, such as freezing or resting.
metrics.definition: Time in immobile bouts. An interval is immobile when hypot(dx, dy) / dt is strictly below the threshold; contiguous immobile intervals form a bout, and bouts shorter than min_immobility_bout_s are ignored.
metrics.formula: sum(bout duration where bout duration >= min_immobility_bout_s)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.
